# Rythenox

> Rythenox is a multi-tenant fleet management and remote operations platform for managed devices. It provides real-time device telemetry, command execution, scheduled playbooks, diagnostic file collection, and team collaboration for IT operators.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Fleet overview with KPIs, live pulse, device inventory, and task activity.
- [Devices](/devices): Managed device inventory with tags, filters, and bulk command runner.
- [Playbooks](/playbooks): Saved command playbooks for repeatable operations.
- [Schedules](/schedules): Cron-based scheduled task dispatch across device filters.
- [Network Infrastructure](/network): Relay nodes, telemetry, and Go bridge heartbeat sync (restricted to @rythenox.com).
- [Deployment Center](/deployment): Manual agent provisioning wizard and build artifacts.
- [File Explorer](/diagnostics): Async file explorer for uploaded diagnostic assets.
- [Messages](/messages): Team channels and direct messages with @mentions.
- [Audit Log](/audit): Tenant-scoped audit trail of administrative actions.
- [Notifications](/notifications): User notification center.
- [Status](/status): Public service status page.
- [Settings](/settings): Account, organization, two-factor authentication, and notification preferences.
- [Docs](/docs): Operator documentation.
